Still a leg inside the 30-bar range, not an accepted breakout.

transition_conditions: A daily close above 2700 (bar 118 high) with a further bull close would mark acceptance of an upside breakout from the 30-bar range and support continued bull-trend/channel behaviour.
A bear close below 2568.16 (bar 119 low) followed by a break of 2357.18 (bar 101 low) would break the 30-bar range low and shift the read toward a lower high under 2771 and a range-down resolution.
Continuation of overlapping bars contained inside 2436.87 (bar 117 low) and 2700 keeps the phase 'range' and keeps always-in relevance low.
A move back below 2293.80 (bar 87 high, the top of the breakout bar's range) would undercut breakout acceptance and move the classification toward transition-unclear.

The last fifteen bars are two-sided overlap inside 2568.16-2700.00 with small bodies (for example 1789819200000 open 2638.59/close 2640.01, 1789833600000 open 2640.01/close 2633.54, 1789848000000 open 2633.54/close 2632.98) and no new trend bar, which is range-like rather than channel-like.

structures.description: Two-sided range dominating the middle of the window: alternating spikes and full retracements between the 2357.18 low (1788336000000) and the 2680.00 high (1789128000000), with overlapping bodies and many reversals. The 1788436800000 bull spike (close 2506.79) was retraced to 2436.73 at 1788523200000, and the 1789128000000 bull spike (close 2555.52) was retraced all the way to 2358.62 at 1789488000000, below its own origin.

Bull breakout above the 2609.02 high of 1789416000000 (a level corroborated by the 2607.62 high of 1789142400000): the 1789732800000/1789761600000 trend bars (closes 2578.6/2636.28) cleared it and 12 of the 15 closes since sit above it. 2700.00 was reached at 1789804800000 and again at 1789948800000. Caveat within the structure: the 1789862400000-1789891200000 pullback closed back below the level on three consecutive bars (2586.68, 2576.9, 2577.88) before recovering.

Rising, overlapping progression from the 2358.62 low (1789488000000): higher swing lows near 2370.54 (1789574400000), 2436.87 (1789689600000) and 2568.16 (1789891200000), against higher highs 2481.66 (1789646400000), 2643.52 (1789761600000) and 2700.00 (1789948800000), with each push separated by two-sided pullback bars.

The fifteen bars from 1789761600000 to 1789977599999 overlap inside 2568.16-2700.00: three bear bars at 1789862400000-1789891200000 erased much of the 1789761600000 advance, a 2700.00 double top formed with upper tails of 61.51 and 35.27 points, and no new trend bar appeared.

transition_conditions: A close above 2700.00 followed by a bar that holds above it would confirm the breakout and extend the bull channel.
A close below 2568.16 (the 1789891200000 low) would break the higher-low sequence and shift the read toward trading-range/range.
Continued overlapping bars between 2568.16 and 2700.00 with shrinking ranges would convert the current channel into a trading range at the highs (phase range).
Repeated closes back below 2609.02 would mark the breakout as failed and re-establish the wide 2357.18-2680.00 range as the operative structure.
A single large bear trend bar closing near its low and below 2609.02 would make the Always-In direction ambiguous rather than long.
